65 bool
66 AstTests::isPrefix(string prefix, string s)
67  {
68  return (s.find(prefix, 0) == 0);
69  }
70 
71 unsigned int
72 AstTests::numPrefix(string prefix, vector<string> vs)
73  {
74  unsigned int num=0;
75  for (vector<string>::iterator it=vs.begin();it!=vs.end();it++)
76  {
77  if (isPrefix(prefix,*it))
78  {
79  num++;
80  }
81  }
82  return num;
83  }
84 
85 unsigned int
86 AstTests::numSuccContainers(SgNode* node) {
87  vector<string> names=node->get_traversalSuccessorNamesContainer();
88  return numPrefix("[0]",names)+numPrefix("*[0]",names);
89 }
90 
91 unsigned int
92 AstTests::numSingleSuccs(SgNode* node) {
93  vector<string> names=node->get_traversalSuccessorNamesContainer();
94  return numPrefix("p_",names);
95 }

97 bool
98 AstTests::isProblematic(SgNode* node)
99  {
100  // This function tests whether a node is problematic for the access of attributes
101  // computed by the processing classes. There are two cases how attributes can be
102  // accessed
103  // 1. by using the (generated) enums
104  // 2. by using an index for an offset in a children container
105  // A node is problematic if both cases are mixed. Therefore this test is included
106  // in the consistancy tests to ensure that no new node that is added to the AST
107  // violates this property.
108 
109  // DQ (4/3/2006 (afternoon)): But I had to change it back since the AST it fails to pass this test.
110  // We need to work more with Markus to fix this!
111  // DQ (4/3/2006 (morning)): Markus called and though this should be changed.
112  // ERROR: Call from Markus, this needs to be switched. But it will cause something to fail.
113  // This is what it takes to allow the enums based interface to work within the traversal.
114 #if 1
115  // DQ (8/10/2004): This is the correct test and no other one is appropriate, I gather!
116  // DQ (4/4/2006): I believe that this was Markus's original code. And while I tried to make
117  // it more clear with the alternative code below this didn't work. So it was put back the
118  // way I understood Markus had designed it.
119  return (numSuccContainers(node) > 1) || ( (numSuccContainers(node) > 0) && (numSingleSuccs(node) > 0) );
120 #else
121  // This case fails, I think because the numberOfDataMembers == 1 (to include the container itself)
122  // actually 1 does not work, so I'm not sure what is going on here! I have sent email to Markus.
123  // int containerSize = numSuccContainers(node);
124  int numberOfContainers = numSuccContainers(node);
125  int numberOfDataMembers = numSingleSuccs(node);
126  // return ( (containerSize > 1) && (numberOfDataMembers == 0)) || ( (containerSize == 0) && (numberOfDataMembers > 0) );
127  return ( (numberOfContainers > 1) && (numberOfDataMembers == 0)) || ( (numberOfContainers == 0) && (numberOfDataMembers > 0) );
128 #endif
129  }

142 // DQ (10/6/2004): This function should be designed to take a SgNode
143 // as input so that any part of the AST could be tested!
144 bool
145 AstTests::isCorrectAst(SgProject* sageProject)
146  {
147  TimingPerformance timer ("AST check for IR nodes without source position information:");
148 
149  TestAstProperties t;
150  bool returnValue = t.traverse(sageProject).val;
151 
152  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL )
153  {
154  printf ("\nAST Diagnostics: Fequency of IR nodes missing ending source postion info: \n");
155 #ifdef __CYGWIN__
156  // PC (9/18/2006): Diagnostic fails on cygwin
157  puts("Diagnostic fails on cygwin");
158 #else
159  bool found = false;
160  for (int i = V_SgModifier; i != V_SgNumVariants; i++)
161  {
162  if (t.nodeWithoutFileInfoFrequencyCount[i] > 0)
163  {
164  found = true;
165  printf (" Frequency at %s = %d \n",getVariantName(VariantT(i)).c_str(),t.nodeWithoutFileInfoFrequencyCount[i]);
166  }
167  }
168 
169  if (found == false)
170  {
171  printf ("PASSED: All IR nodes have both starting and ending position information \n");
172  }
173 #endif
174  }
175 
176  return returnValue;
177  }

1739  // DQ (5/9/2005): Make sure that all non-templated IR nodes are marked as SgDeclarationStatement::e_no_specialization.
1740  SgVariableDeclaration *variableDeclaration = isSgVariableDeclaration(astNode);
1741  if (variableDeclaration != NULL)
1742  {
1743  SgScopeStatement* scope = variableDeclaration->get_scope();
1744  SgClassDefinition* classDefinition = isSgClassDefinition(scope);
1745  if (classDefinition != NULL)
1746  {
1747  SgTemplateClassDefinition* templateClassDefinition = isSgTemplateClassDefinition(classDefinition);
1748  if (templateClassDefinition != NULL)
1749  {
1750  // Special case...debugging new use of SgTemplateClassDefinition.
1751 #ifdef ROSE_DEBUG_NEW_EDG_ROSE_CONNECTION
1752  printf ("AST ConsistancyTest: TestAstTemplateProperties Found a case of SgTemplateClassDefinition (case not handled) \n");
1753 #endif
1754  }
1755  else
1756  {
1757  SgClassDeclaration* classDeclaration = classDefinition->get_declaration();
1758  ROSE_ASSERT(classDeclaration != NULL);
1759  if (isSgTemplateInstantiationDecl(classDefinition->get_declaration()) == NULL)
1760  {
1761  // This is NOT a data member of the templated class (or nested class of a templated class)
1762  if (variableDeclaration->get_specialization() != SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization)
1763  {
1764 #ifdef ROSE_DEBUG_NEW_EDG_ROSE_CONNECTION
1765  printf ("Note: AST ConsistancyTest: variableDeclaration->get_specialization() = %d != SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization (variableDeclaration = %p) \n",variableDeclaration->get_specialization(),variableDeclaration);
1766  variableDeclaration->get_file_info()->display("variableDeclaration->get_specialization() != SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization");
1767 #endif
1768  }
1769  // DQ (6/30/2005): Commented out to focus more on KULL, output a warning for now!
1770  // ROSE_ASSERT(variableDeclaration->get_specialization() == SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization);
1771  }
1772  else
1773  {
1774  // Make sure that all template class declarations are associated with a template definition!
1775  if (isSgTemplateInstantiationDefn(classDefinition) == NULL)
1776  {
1777  printf ("Warning: classDefinition = %p = %s \n",classDefinition,classDefinition != NULL ? classDefinition->class_name().c_str() : "null");
1778  }
1779 
1780  // DQ (1/1/2012): I think we can assert that this is only a SgClassDefinition (but leave the warning message above).
1781  // ROSE_ASSERT(isSgTemplateInstantiationDefn(classDefinition) != NULL);
1782  ROSE_ASSERT(isSgClassDefinition(classDefinition) != NULL);
1783  }
1784  }
1785  }
1786  }
1787 
1788  // DQ (5/9/2005): Make sure that all non-templated IR nodes are marked as SgDeclarationStatement::e_no_specialization.
1789  SgClassDeclaration *classDeclaration = isSgClassDeclaration(astNode);
1790  if (classDeclaration != NULL)
1791  {
1792  if (isSgTemplateInstantiationDecl(classDeclaration) == NULL)
1793  {
1794  // this is NOT a data member of the templated class (or nested class of a templated class)
1795  if (classDeclaration->get_specialization() != SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization)
1796  {
1797  printf ("AST ConsistancyTest: classDeclaration = %p = %s classDeclaration->get_specialization() = %d != SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization \n",
1798  classDeclaration,classDeclaration->get_name().str(),classDeclaration->get_specialization());
1799  printf (" classDeclaration at file %s line = %d \n",
1800  classDeclaration->get_file_info()->get_raw_filename().c_str(),
1801  classDeclaration->get_file_info()->get_raw_line());
1802  }
1803  ROSE_ASSERT(classDeclaration->get_specialization() == SgClassDeclaration::e_no_specialization);
1804  }
1805  }
1806 
1807  // DQ (5/9/2005): Make sure that all non-templated IR nodes are marked as SgDeclarationStatement::e_no_specialization.
1808  SgFunctionDeclaration *functionDeclaration = isSgFunctionDeclaration(astNode);

1810  {
1811  if ( isSgTemplateInstantiationFunctionDecl(functionDeclaration) == NULL &&
1812  isSgTemplateInstantiationMemberFunctionDecl(functionDeclaration) == NULL )

1815  ROSE_ASSERT(functionDeclaration->get_specialization() == SgFunctionDeclaration::e_no_specialization);
1816  }
1817  }
1818  }
1819  }

2102 bool
2103 TestAstForProperlyMangledNames::isValidMangledName (string name, bool java_lang /* = false */ )
2104  {
2105  // DQ (4/3/2011): This function has been modified to permit Java specific weakened restrictions
2106  // on names. The default for java_lang is false. If a test fails the current language is
2107  // determined and java_lang set to true if the current langage is Java for the associated SgFile.
2108 
2109  bool result = true;
2110 
2111  if (name.empty () || isdigit (name[0]))
2112  {
2113  result = false;
2114  }
2115 
2116  if (java_lang == true)
2117  {
2118  // The case for Java has to allow a few more characters into names (e.g. '$')
2119  for (string::size_type i = 0; i < name.size (); ++i)
2120  {
2121  // printf ("java_lang == true: isalnum (name = %s name[i] = %c) = %s \n",name.c_str(),name[i],isalnum (name[i]) ? "true" : "false");
2122  if (!isalnum (name[i]) && !(name[i] == '_' || name[i] == '$'))
2123  {
2124  result = false;
2125  }
2126  }
2127  }
2128  else
2129  {
2130  for (string::size_type i = 0; i < name.size (); ++i)
2131  {
2132  // printf ("java_lang == false: isalnum (name = %s name[i] = %c) = %s \n",name.c_str(),name[i],isalnum (name[i]) ? "true" : "false");
2133  if (!isalnum (name[i]) && name[i] != '_')
2134  {
2135  result = false;
2136  }
2137  }
2138  }
2139 
2140 #if 0
2141  if (result == false)
2142  {
2143  printf ("ERROR: isValidMangledName(name = %s) == false \n",name.c_str());
2144  }
2145 #endif
2146 
2147  return result;
2148  }

2160 void
2161 TestAstForUniqueStatementsInScopes::visit ( SgNode* node )
2162  {
2163  // DQ (3/31/2004): Added to locate scopes that have redundent statements.
2164  // This could happen either because of a bug in the EDG/SAGE connection,
2165  // or as a result of using the rewrite mechanism inappropriately.
2166 
2167  // printf ("node = %s \n",node->sage_class_name());
2168 
2169  // DQ (4/1/2004): Added code to detect redundent statements in a scope!
2170  SgScopeStatement* scope = isSgScopeStatement(node);
2171  if (scope != NULL)
2172  {
2173  // Generate a list of statements in the scope (even if they are really declaration statements)
2174  SgStatementPtrList statementList;
2175  switch ( scope->variantT() )
2176  {
2177  case V_SgIfStmt:
2178  {
2179  SgIfStmt* ifStatement = isSgIfStmt(scope);
2180  ROSE_ASSERT (ifStatement != NULL);
2181  statementList = isSgBasicBlock(ifStatement->get_true_body()) ? isSgBasicBlock(ifStatement->get_true_body())->generateStatementList() : SgStatementPtrList(1, ifStatement->get_true_body());
2182  SgStatementPtrList falseStatementList = isSgBasicBlock(ifStatement->get_false_body()) ? isSgBasicBlock(ifStatement->get_false_body())->generateStatementList() : ifStatement->get_false_body() ? SgStatementPtrList(1, ifStatement->get_false_body()) : SgStatementPtrList();
2183 
2184  // statementList.merge(falseStatementList);
2185  statementList.insert(statementList.end(),falseStatementList.begin(),falseStatementList.end());
2186 
2187  break;
2188  }
2189  case V_SgDeclarationScope:
2190  break;
2191  default:
2192  statementList = scope->generateStatementList();
2193  }
2194  // MK (8/3/05) : Rewrote this test to ignore statements which are marked as shared. These may actually exist multiple times in a scope
2195 
2196  // seenStatements is a unique container. Thus, we know that a statement can only go into it once. If
2197  // encounter a statement twice, then it will go into duplicateStatements, where we can report it
2198  // later, if necessary.
2199  set<SgStatement *> seenStatements;
2200  list<SgStatement *> duplicateStatements;
2201  seenStatements.clear();
2202  duplicateStatements.clear();
2203 
2204  // Set this to false if we should fail the test
2205  bool pass = true;
2206 
2207  // This gives us the total number of statements checked, useful for reporting
2208  int totalStatements = statementList.size();
2209  int numberOfDuplicates = 0;
2210  int numberOfUniques = 0;
2211  int numberOfShared = 0;
2212 
2213  // Go through the statements, and put any duplicates found into duplicateStatements
2214  for (SgStatementPtrList::iterator i = statementList.begin(); i != statementList.end(); i++)
2215  {
2216  SgStatement * currStatement = *i;
2217 
2218  // ignore shared nodes
2219  if (currStatement->get_file_info()->isShared())
2220  {
2221  numberOfShared++;
2222  }
2223  else
2224  {
2225  // DQ (2/22/2007): It is likely that count is more expensive than find since we only want existence.
2226  if (seenStatements.count(currStatement) == 0)
2227  {
2228  seenStatements.insert(currStatement);
2229  numberOfUniques++;
2230  }
2231  else
2232  {
2233  duplicateStatements.push_back(currStatement);
2234  numberOfDuplicates++;
2235  }
2236  }
2237  }
2238 
2239  // If there are duplicate statements, we have an error
2240  if (numberOfDuplicates != 0)
2241  {
2242  pass = false;
2243  }
2244 
2245  if (!pass)
2246  {
2247  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL || true )
2248  {
2249  cout << "Problematic Node: " << node->sage_class_name() << " found. (a statement appears more than once in this scope)" << endl;
2250 
2251  printf ("Error: number of [non-shared] statements = %d number of unique statements = %d \n",
2252  totalStatements - numberOfShared, numberOfUniques);
2253 
2254  // verify that there are duplicates
2255  ROSE_ASSERT(numberOfDuplicates > 0);
2256 
2257  printf ("Number of duplicate statements = %d \n",numberOfDuplicates);
2258 #if 0
2259  printf ("Exiting as a test ... \n");
2260  ROSE_ABORT();
2261 #endif
2262  int counter = 0;
2263  for (list<SgStatement *>::iterator j = duplicateStatements.begin(); j != duplicateStatements.end(); j++)
2264  {
2265  SgStatement * currDuplicate = *j;
2266  ROSE_ASSERT(currDuplicate != NULL);
2267 
2268  // DQ (6/26/2016): Debugging a special case that appears with ROSE compiles "rose.h" header file.
2269  SgTemplateInstantiationDefn* templateInstantiationDefn = isSgTemplateInstantiationDefn(node);
2270  if (templateInstantiationDefn != NULL)
2271  {
2272  SgTemplateInstantiationDecl* templateInstantiationDecl = isSgTemplateInstantiationDecl(templateInstantiationDefn->get_declaration());
2273  ROSE_ASSERT(templateInstantiationDecl != NULL);
2274  printf ("ERROR: problem declaration: templateInstantiationDecl = %p = %s \n",templateInstantiationDecl,templateInstantiationDecl->get_name().str());
2275  }
2276 
2277  Sg_File_Info * location = currDuplicate->get_file_info();
2278  ROSE_ASSERT(location != NULL);
2279  printf ("Error: node (%d/%d) = %p = %s at: \n",counter,numberOfDuplicates,currDuplicate,currDuplicate->sage_class_name());
2280 
2281  // DQ (3/21/2011): Added more detail to debug duplicate entries...
2282  printf ("currDuplicate name = %s \n",SageInterface::get_name(currDuplicate).c_str());
2283 
2284  if (location != NULL)
2285  {

5110 // DQ (9/13/2006): Implemented by Ghassan to verify that for
5111 // each node, it appears in its parent's list of children.
5112 // This is a test requested by Jeremiah.
5113 void
5114 TestChildPointersInMemoryPool::visit( SgNode *node )
5115  {
5116  static std::map<SgNode*,std::set<SgNode*> > childMap;
5117 
5118  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
5119 
5120  if (node->get_freepointer() != AST_FileIO::IS_VALID_POINTER() )
5121  {
5122  printf ("Error: In TestChildPointersInMemoryPool::visit() for node = %s at %p \n",node->class_name().c_str(),node);
5123  ROSE_ABORT();
5124  }
5125 
5126  SgNode *parent = node->get_parent();
5127 
5128 #if ROSE_USE_VALGRIND
5129  VALGRIND_CHECK_DEFINED(parent);
5130 #endif
5131 
5132  if (parent != NULL)
5133  {
5134  bool nodeFound = false;
5135 
5136  // DQ (3/12/2007): This is the latest implementation, here we look for the child set
5137  // in a statically defined childMap. This should be a more efficient implementation.
5138  // Since it uses a static map it is a problem when the function is called twice.
5139  std::map<SgNode*,std::set<SgNode*> >::iterator it = childMap.find(parent);
5140 
5141  if (it != childMap.end())
5142  {
5143  // Reuse the set that was built the first time
5144  nodeFound = it->second.find(node) != it->second.end();
5145 
5146  // DQ (7/1/2008): When this function is called a second time, (typically as part
5147  // of calling AstTests::runAllTests (SgProject*); with a modified AST,
5148  // the childMap has already been set and any new declaration that was added and
5149  // which generated a symbol is not in the previously defined static childMap.
5150  // So the test above fails and we need to use the more expensive dynamic test.
5151  // George Vulov (4/22/2011): Restrict this test to only memory pool entries that are valid
5152  if (nodeFound == false && parent->get_freepointer() == AST_FileIO::IS_VALID_POINTER())
5153  nodeFound = parent->isChild(node);
5154  }
5155  else
5156  {
5157  // DQ (6/6/2010): Restrict this test to only memory pool entries that are valid
5158  if (parent->get_freepointer() == AST_FileIO::IS_VALID_POINTER() )
5159  {
5160  // build the set (and do the test)
5161  childMap[parent] = std::set<SgNode*>();
5162  it = childMap.find(parent);
5163  ROSE_ASSERT (it != childMap.end());
5164 
5165  // Later we can make this more efficient by building a set directly
5166  // This style is quite inefficient since we are not making use of
5167  // the string type date in the pair<SgNode*,string>
5168 #if ROSE_USE_VALGRIND
5169  if (VALGRIND_CHECK_WRITABLE(parent, sizeof(SgNode))) {
5170  fprintf(stderr, "Parent %p of child %p (a %s) has been deleted.\n", parent, node, node->class_name().c_str());
5171  }
5172 #endif
5173 
5174 #if 0
5175  // DQ (6/5/2010): Turn this on to support debugging of the AST File I/O support for reading files (tests/nonsmoke/functional/testAstFileRead.C).
5176 
5177  /* DEBUGGING (RPM 2008-10-10)
5178  * If the call to parent->returnDataMemberPointers() fails it could be due to the fact that the parent has been
5179  * deleted without deleting its children. This can happen if the parent's definition in one of the *.C files
5180  * in src/ROSETTA/src (such as binaryInstruction.C) has a call to setAutomaticGenerationOfDestructor with false
5181  * to turn off the ROSETTA-generated destructor and the explicitly coded destructor does not destroy child
5182  * nodes. */

5789  if (binaryOperator != NULL)

5791  switch (expression->variantT())

5793  // IR nodes that have an l-value
5794  case V_SgAssignOp:

5809  // DQ (1/22/2008): Jeremiah has provided a patch for this. This used to be violated by the
5810  // ROSE/tests/nonsmoke/functional/roseTests/astInliningTests/pass16.C test code! This is now violated by
5811  // the ./preTest

5813  // test code!
5814  if (lhs->get_lvalue() == false)

5820 
5821  // I don't want to comment this out, it is always set correctly except in the inlining transformation!
5822  // It now passes the inliner tests, but fails in the
5823  // tests/nonsmoke/functional/roseTests/programTransformationTests, so I have to comment it out again!
5824  ROSE_ASSERT(lhs->get_lvalue() == true);
5825  break;
5826  }
5827 
5828  case V_SgDotExp:
5829  case V_SgArrowExp:
5830  {
5831  SgExpression* lhs = binaryOperator->get_lhs_operand();
5832  ROSE_ASSERT(lhs != NULL);
5833 #if WARN_ABOUT_ATYPICAL_LVALUES

5836  // ROSE_ASSERT(lhs->get_lvalue() == true);

5838  }
5839 
5840  default:
5841  {
5842  // Make sure that the lhs is not an L-value
5843  SgExpression* lhs = binaryOperator->get_lhs_operand();
5844  ROSE_ASSERT(lhs != NULL);
5845 
5846 #if WARN_ABOUT_ATYPICAL_LVALUES
5847  if (lhs->get_lvalue() == true)
5848  {
5849  printf ("Error for lhs = %p = %s = %s in binary expression = %s \n",

5860 
5861 #if WARN_ABOUT_ATYPICAL_LVALUES

5868 #endif
5869  // ROSE_ASSERT(rhs->get_lvalue() == false);
5870  }

5872  SgUnaryOp* unaryOperator = isSgUnaryOp(expression);
5873  if (unaryOperator != NULL)
5874  {
5875  switch (expression->variantT())
5876  {
5877  // IR nodes that should have a valid lvalue
5878  // What about SgAddressOfOp?
5879 
5880  case V_SgMinusMinusOp:
5881  case V_SgPlusPlusOp:
5882  {
5883  SgExpression* operand = unaryOperator->get_operand();

5886 #if WARN_ABOUT_ATYPICAL_LVALUES

5891  <<": operand->get_lvalue() == false but should be true\n";
5892  std::cerr <<"ancestors of (" <<operand->class_name() <<"*)" <<operand <<" are:";
5893  for (SgNode *p=operand->get_parent(); p; p=p->get_parent())

5896  unaryOperator->get_startOfConstruct()
5897  ->display("Error for operand: operand->get_lvalue() == false: debug");

5899 #endif

5949 #if WARN_ABOUT_ATYPICAL_LVALUES

5999 void
6000 BuildListOfConnectedNodesInAST::visit(SgNode * node)
6001  {
6002  // printf ("Node = %p = %s \n",node,node->class_name().c_str());
6003 
6004  if (nodeSet.find(node) == nodeSet.end())
6005  {
6006  // Not found in the set, add to the set and call visit function on all children.
6007  nodeSet.insert(node);
6008 
6009  typedef vector<pair<SgNode*,string> > DataMemberMapType;
6010  DataMemberMapType dataMemberMap = node->returnDataMemberPointers();
6011 
6012  DataMemberMapType::iterator i = dataMemberMap.begin();
6013  while (i != dataMemberMap.end())
6014  {
6015  // Ignore the parent pointer since it will be reset differently if required
6016  SgNode* childPointer = i->first;
6017  string debugString = i->second;
6018 
6019  if (childPointer != NULL)
6020  {
6021  // Make the recursive call
6022  visit(childPointer);
6023 
6024  SgLocatedNode* locatedNode = isSgLocatedNode(childPointer);
6025  if (locatedNode != NULL)
6026  {
6027  AttachedPreprocessingInfoType* comments = locatedNode->getAttachedPreprocessingInfo();
6028 
6029  if (comments != NULL)
6030  {
6031  // printf ("Found attached comments (at %p of type: %s): \n",locatedNode,locatedNode->sage_class_name());
6032  AttachedPreprocessingInfoType::iterator i;
6033  for (i = comments->begin(); i != comments->end(); i++)
6034  {
6035  ROSE_ASSERT ( (*i) != NULL );
6036  visit((*i)->get_file_info());
6037 
6038 #if 0
6039  printf (" Attached Comment (relativePosition=%s): %s\n",
6040  ((*i)->getRelativePosition() == PreprocessingInfo::before) ? "before" : "after",
6041  (*i)->getString().c_str());
6042  printf ("Comment/Directive getNumberOfLines = %d getColumnNumberOfEndOfString = %d \n",(*i)->getNumberOfLines(),(*i)->getColumnNumberOfEndOfString());
6043  (*i)->get_file_info()->display("comment/directive location");
6044 #endif
6045  }
6046  }
6047  }
6048  }
6049  i++;
6050  }
6051  }
6052  else
6053  {
6054  // Found in the set, nothing to do.
6055  }
6056  }

6172 TestForProperLanguageAndSymbolTableCaseSensitivity_InheritedAttribute
6173 TestForProperLanguageAndSymbolTableCaseSensitivity::evaluateInheritedAttribute(SgNode* node, TestForProperLanguageAndSymbolTableCaseSensitivity_InheritedAttribute inheritedAttribute)
6174  {
6175  // The default is to make all symbol tables (scopes) case sensitive, and then detect use of Fortran
6176  // files (SgSourceFile IR nodes) and make all of their symbol tables (scopes) case insensitive.
6177  TestForProperLanguageAndSymbolTableCaseSensitivity_InheritedAttribute return_inheritedAttribute(inheritedAttribute);
6178 
6179  SgSourceFile* sourceFile = isSgSourceFile(node);
6180  if (sourceFile != NULL)
6181  {
6182  // printf ("Found SgSourceFile for %s get_Fortran_only() = %s \n",sourceFile->getFileName().c_str(),sourceFile->get_Fortran_only() ? "true" : "false");
6183 
6184  return_inheritedAttribute.sourceFile = sourceFile;
6185  if (isCaseInsensitive(sourceFile))
6186  {
6187  return_inheritedAttribute.caseInsensitive = true;
6188  }
6189  }
6190

6250 void
6251 TestForReferencesToDeletedNodes::visit ( SgNode* node )
6252  {
6253  // DQ (9/26/2011): This is a new test for possible references to deleted IR nodes in the AST (dangling pointers).
6254  // It works as a byproduct of the way that memory pool works. It might work better if we also added an option
6255  // to prevent previously deleted IR nodes from reusing memory in the memory pool. This can be considered for
6256  // future work.
6257 
6258  ROSE_ASSERT(node != NULL);
6259  // printf ("TestForReferencesToDeletedNodes::visit: node = %s \n",node->class_name().c_str());
6260 
6261  // Only output information about this test if set to value greater than zero (this avoids anoying output for existing translators, e.g. CAF2 work).
6262  if (detect_dangling_pointers > 0)
6263  {
6264  vector<pair<SgNode*,string> > v = node->returnDataMemberPointers();
6265 
6266  for (unsigned long i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
6267  {
6268  SgNode* child = v[i].first;
6269 
6270  if (child != NULL && child->variantT() == V_SgNode)
6271  {
6272  // This is a deleted IR node
6273  // SgFile* file = TransformationSupport::getFile(node);
6274  // string filename = (file != NULL) ? file->getFileName() : "unknown file";
6275  printf ("Error in AST consistancy detect_dangling_pointers test for file %s: Found a child = %p = %s child name = %s of node = %p = %s that was previously deleted \n",filename.c_str(),child,child->class_name().c_str(),v[i].second.c_str(),node,node->class_name().c_str());
6276  }
6277 
6278  // DQ (9/26/2011): This fails for the projects/UpcTranslation upc_shared_2.upc file...figure this out once we see what elase might file.
6279  // Other fialing tests include:
6280  // projects/backstroke/tests/expNormalizationTest/test2006_74.C
6281  // projects/backstroke/tests/expNormalizationTest/test2006_87.C
6282  // Large percentage of Fortran tests fail this test!
6283  if (detect_dangling_pointers > 1)
6284  {
6285  ROSE_ASSERT( (child == NULL) || (child != NULL && child->variantT() != V_SgNode) );
6286  }
6287  }
6288  }
6289  }

6333 TestForParentsMatchingASTStructure::preOrderVisit(SgNode *node)
6334  {
6335  if (!stack.empty())
6336  {
6337  if (NULL == node->get_parent())
6338  {
6339  // output << prefix << "node has null parent property but was reached by AST traversal\n";
6340  printf ("In TestForParentsMatchingASTStructure::preOrderVisit(): (NULL == node->get_parent()): node class_name = %s , prefix = %s node's parent property is NULL\n",node->class_name().c_str(), prefix.c_str());
6341 
6342  show_details_and_maybe_fail(node);
6343  }
6344  else
6345  {
6346  if (node->get_parent() != stack.back())
6347  {
6348  // output << prefix << "node's parent property does not match traversal parent\n";
6349  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL )
6350  {
6351  printf ("In TestForParentsMatchingASTStructure::preOrderVisit(): (node->get_parent() != stack.back()): prefix = %s node's parent property does not match traversal parent\n",prefix.c_str());
6352  printf ("traversal parent = %p = %s \n",stack.back(),stack.back()->class_name().c_str());
6353  }
6354  SgNamespaceDefinitionStatement* namespaceDefinition = isSgNamespaceDefinitionStatement(stack.back());
6355 
6356  if (namespaceDefinition != NULL)
6357  {
6358  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL )
6359  {
6360  printf ("node = %p = %s node->get_parent() = %p = %s \n",node,node->class_name().c_str(),node->get_parent(),node->get_parent()->class_name().c_str());
6361  }
6362 
6363  SgNamespaceDeclarationStatement* namespaceDeclaration = namespaceDefinition->get_namespaceDeclaration();
6364  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL )
6365  {
6366  printf ("Found a namespaceDefinition = %p = %s \n",namespaceDefinition,namespaceDeclaration->get_name().str());
6367  }
6368 
6369  SgNamespaceDefinitionStatement* previousNamespaceDefinition = namespaceDefinition;
6370  while (previousNamespaceDefinition != NULL)
6371  {
6372  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() >= DIAGNOSTICS_VERBOSE_LEVEL )
6373  {
6374  printf ("previousNamespaceDefinition = %p \n",previousNamespaceDefinition);
6375  }
6376 
6377  previousNamespaceDefinition = previousNamespaceDefinition->get_previousNamespaceDefinition();
6378  }
6379  }
6380 
6381  show_details_and_maybe_fail(node);
6382  }
6383  }
6384  }
6385 
6386  stack.push_back(node);
6387  }
